name: Columbia (STS-58)
about: Columbia (STS-58) (1993-065A), a crewed vehicle (OV-102), launched 1993 Oct 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1993 Oct 20), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW22); its coordinates are written from memory
